bullets.text: Built a Rust order-routing service handling 40,000 requests per minute and cut p99 latency by 35 percent.
Led a team of four engineers and migrated PostgreSQL 12 to 15 with no downtime.
Wrote Python data pipelines on AWS Lambda that processed 2 million claims per day, and added integration tests that reduced production incidents by 20 percent.
Proficient in languages and technologies including Rust, Python, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, AWS, and gRPC.

summary.text: Experience building low-latency services using Rust, including handling 40,000 requests per minute.
Skilled in core backend technologies required, such as Rust, PostgreSQL, AWS, and gRPC.
Proven ability to lead engineering efforts, including a major database migration with zero downtime.
